name: Sungrow Power Supply Co., Ltd. (阳光电源股份有限公司)
summary: Sungrow is one of the world's largest manufacturers of solar PV inverters and battery energy storage systems, founded in 1997 by Hefei University of Technology academic Cao Renxian, with additional businesses in wind power converters, EV drive/charging equipment, floating PV, hydrogen electrolyzers, and renewable plant development. Listed on Shenzhen's ChiNext since 2011; a Hong Kong H-share application was re-filed in April 2026 (the first, from October 2025, lapsed) — the A+H structure was pending as of August 2026.
ecosystemRole: Ranked No. 1 in BOTH Wood Mackenzie's Global BESS Integrator Comprehensive Ranking and its Global PV Inverter Manufacturer Comprehensive Ranking (2026 edition, assessing 2025) — the first company to take the integrator top spot from Tesla. Company-reported 2025 shipments: 43 GWh of storage (+53.5%) and 143 GW of inverters. ESS revenue overtook inverters as the largest segment in FY2025 (41.8% of revenue at a 36.5% gross margin). BloombergNEF has named Sungrow the most bankable ESS and PCS brand.

productsAndServices.name: Utility-scale string inverters — SG-HX series (SG350HX / SG510HX / SG465HX)
productsAndServices.description: 1,500 Vdc multi-MPPT string inverters for utility-scale plants. The established SG350HX delivers 352 kVA with up to 16 MPPTs (2 strings each, 20 A per string), 99% max efficiency, IP66, integrated DC switch and 24-hour AC/DC insulation monitoring. The new flagship SG510HX (SG465HX is the Middle East variant, unveiled at WFES 2026 in January) moves to an AC 1,000 V architecture: 465 kW output, up to 6 MPPTs, 99% max efficiency, 9.84 MW subarray capacity, PV-side grid-forming (PV-GFM) capability, and an upgraded DC-side safety package (redundant shutdown, full-coverage temperature sensing, MPPT-level fault localization). Total company inverter shipments in 2025 were 143 GW, down ~2.7% YoY as China's residential market contracted after the '531' policy, while overseas shipments grew ~12%.
highlights: SG510HX completed an extreme-condition safety validation at a 4,200 m altitude PV plant (2026)
AC 1,000 V system design cuts subarray count and BOS cost vs 800 V-class predecessors (company claim)
productsAndServices.positioning: Sungrow and Huawei are the two dominant global PV inverter vendors — together holding over 55% of the global market as of mid-2025, with SMA and other Western vendors losing share. Sungrow ranked No. 1 in Wood Mackenzie's Global PV Inverter Manufacturer Comprehensive Ranking (2026 edition, assessing 2025).
productsAndServices.soldThrough: Direct to utility-scale EPCs, developers, and IPPs; regional subsidiaries handle logistics, commissioning support, and service
productsAndServices.targetSegments: Utility-scale PV plants globally, including high-altitude, desert, and MEA extreme-heat sites
productsAndServices.roadmap: AC 1,000 V generation (SG510HX/SG465HX) rolling out through 2026 alongside spreading PV grid-forming (PV-GFM) capability

productsAndServices.name: '1+X' modular inverters (utility central-class)
productsAndServices.description: Modular alternative to conventional central inverters. Original 1+X (2022): 1.1 MW single units paralleling up to 8.8 MW (8 units). 1+X 2.0 (April 2025): 800 kW modules paralleling up to 9.6 MW (12 units) — 30% finer power granularity than gen 1 for more flexible block design and lower LCOE. 99% max efficiency, no derating up to 52°C (MEA variant), arc-fault isolation within 40 ms at the combiner box, AI-driven fault detection, and grid-forming with equivalent inertia support within 5 ms. Split modular design isolates critical components (IGBTs, capacitors) in an upper module for quick field replacement.
highlights: Deployed with Zelestra's 220 MWdc Aurora hybrid project in Chile alongside 1 GWh of PowerTitan BESS
Original 1+X took 500+ MW of orders within months of its 2022 launch
productsAndServices.positioning: Bridges the string-vs-central trade-off: central-class economics with module-level serviceability — competing against conventional central inverters (SMA, TMEIC, Power Electronics) and large string fleets in utility tenders
productsAndServices.soldThrough: Direct to utility-scale EPCs, developers, and IPPs
productsAndServices.targetSegments: Large utility-scale PV blocks, hybrid PV+storage plants, extreme-heat MEA sites
productsAndServices.roadmap: 1+X 2.0 launched April 2025 at the Global Renewable Energy Summit; MEA-optimized variant promoted through 2026

productsAndServices.name: C&I and residential PV & hybrid inverters + battery systems
productsAndServices.description: Single-phase SH-RS hybrid inverters (3–10 kW, 50 V start voltage, 16 A string input) and three-phase SH15/20/25T hybrids (up to 25 kW, 3 MPPTs, <10 ms EPS backup switchover, 100% unbalanced backup load), paired with stackable LFP batteries: SBR series (3.2 kWh modules, 9.6–25.6 kWh per stack) and the newer SBH series (5 kWh modules, 25–40 kWh per stack, up to 4 stacks in parallel for 160 kWh). SG-CX string inverters cover C&I rooftops.
highlights: Australian distributor Raystech contracted to supply 1 GWh of Sungrow BESS in 2026 — 600 MWh residential, 150 MWh C&I, 250 MWh utility-scale
SBR/SBH batteries and SH hybrids sold as a matched ecosystem (batteries pair only with Sungrow hybrid inverters)
productsAndServices.positioning: Consistently ranked among the top residential/hybrid inverter brands globally alongside Huawei, GoodWe, SMA, and Fronius; value positioning with a wide power range under one brand
productsAndServices.soldThrough: Distribution — national/regional distributors (e.g. Raystech, Supply Partners, Tradezone in Australia) selling into installer networks
productsAndServices.targetSegments: Residential solar+storage households (Europe, Australia, emerging markets), C&I rooftop owners
productsAndServices.roadmap: 2026 distribution agreements signed November 2025 at All-Energy Australia signal a storage-attach push in distributed channels

productsAndServices.name: Utility-scale BESS — PowerTitan 1.0 / 2.0 / 3.0
productsAndServices.description: Liquid-cooled containerized systems and the company's largest revenue line since FY2025. PowerTitan 2.0 (the volume workhorse): 5 MWh battery + 2.5 MW PCS AC-block in one 20-ft container — the AC-DC block design raises round-trip efficiency ~2% and cuts fault losses 92% (company claims). PowerTitan 3.0 (June 2025): built on the first mass-producible 684 Ah LFP cell with silicon-carbide PCS, in Flex 3.45 MWh / Class 6.9 MWh (20-ft) / Plus 12.5 MWh (30-ft) versions, scaling to 27.6 MWh per four-block configuration; a European 4-hour variant (Madrid launch, January 2026) packages 1.78 MW PCS with 7.14 MWh per 20-ft container, one block reaching 7.2 MW / 28.5 MWh. 2025 storage shipments: 43 GWh (+53.5%).
highlights: 7.8 GWh Algihaz Holding order in Saudi Arabia (July 2024 — then the world's largest ESS order; 1,500+ PowerTitan 2.0 units, grid-connected 2025 and described by Sungrow as the world's largest grid-forming storage plant)
7.5 GWh of PowerTitan 3.0 + 2.6 GW of inverters for Masdar's 5.2 GW/19 GWh round-the-clock Abu Dhabi project (May 2026, ~40% of its battery capacity, COD 2027)
1 GWh Aurora hybrid project (Zelestra, Chile) energized May 2026; 1 GWh European framework agreement with owner-operator Delta Capacity and a 1.7 GWh UK developer supply deal signed 2026

Safety record anchored on the world's largest BESS burn tests: 10 MWh PowerTitan 1.0 (June 2024) and ~$4.2M, DNV-witnessed 20 MWh PowerTitan 2.0 test (November 2024) — no fire propagation with suppression disabled, >1,385°C contained, 25+ hours of combustion
PowerTitan 3.0 won The smarter E AWARD 2026 (Energy Storage category); Sungrow estimates ~10 GWh of PowerTitan 3.0 deliveries across Europe in 2026
productsAndServices.positioning: No. 1 in Wood Mackenzie's inaugural Global BESS Integrator Comprehensive Ranking (2026, assessing 2025) — the first vendor to take the top spot from Tesla; BloombergNEF's most bankable ESS brand. Competes head-on with Tesla (Megapack 3 / 20 MWh Megablock, US-manufactured from late 2026), CATL (TENER Stack, 9 MWh stackable) and BYD (top 2025 deployer by some rankings) — differentiating on AC-block integration, grid-forming maturity, burn-tested safety, and harsh-climate (MEA) engineering.
productsAndServices.soldThrough: Direct to developers, IPPs, and utilities; multi-GWh framework agreements with owner-operators; delivered as integrated AC blocks with MV skid options
productsAndServices.targetSegments: Utility-scale storage globally — Middle East giga-projects, European grid-services and capacity markets, Americas, Australia
productsAndServices.roadmap: 2026 management target of ≥60 GWh storage shipments circulating from investor-briefing recaps (unverified against a filing); PowerTitan 3.0 ramping as the lead product through 2026–2027 with the Masdar project's COD in 2027

productsAndServices.name: C&I energy storage — PowerStack series
productsAndServices.description: Liquid-cooled C&I systems covering 400 V–35 kV applications. PowerStack 255CS (April 2025): fully integrated AC block on 314 Ah LFP cells — 257 kWh (2-hour, 125 kW) or 514 kWh (4-hour) per cabinet, >90% system round-trip efficiency, up to 98.5% PCS efficiency, AI-controlled liquid cooling that cuts auxiliary consumption ~33% and holds cell temperature spread ≤2.5°C, 20-year design life, UL9540 / NFPA855/69/68 certifications with multi-stage fire suppression. Sits alongside the larger PowerStack 510CS/545 class.
highlights: PowerStack ST255CS shown for MEA markets at WFES 2026 (January) alongside the SG465HX
Integrated EMS + PCS + BMS in one cabinet — positioned as 'plug-and-play' C&I storage
productsAndServices.positioning: Competes in the fast-consolidating C&I storage segment against Tesla (Powerpack-class), Sinexcel-powered integrators, and domestic Chinese cabinet vendors — leaning on utility-derived liquid cooling, safety certification depth, and the installed PV base for attach sales
productsAndServices.soldThrough: Distribution and certified system-integrator/installer partners; direct for larger multi-cabinet projects
productsAndServices.targetSegments: Commercial & industrial facilities doing peak shaving, demand-charge management, PV self-consumption, and backup
productsAndServices.roadmap: Launched April 2025 (Global Renewable Energy Summit) with global rollout through 2025–2026 including MEA variant

productsAndServices.name: Storage PCS & grid-forming technology
productsAndServices.description: In-house storage PCS line spanning C&I modules to the fully liquid-cooled silicon-carbide PCS integrated in PowerTitan 3.0 (99.3% conversion efficiency, company figure), plus MV power-conversion/transformer skids. The umbrella 'Stem Cell Grid-Forming' technology provides seamless switching between grid-following and grid-forming modes, 0 ms grid transitions, active harmonic absorption, inertia support, and black-start capability across PV, wind, and storage product lines.
highlights: Grid-forming validated at giga-scale: the 7.8 GWh Saudi fleet is described as the world's largest grid-forming energy storage plant
Grid-forming utility ESS formally brought to Europe January 2026 (Madrid launch) as grid codes tighten
productsAndServices.positioning: Grid-forming maturity at deployed giga-scale is the key differentiator vs BESS rivals still piloting synthetic-inertia features; PV-side grid-forming (PV-GFM on SG510HX/SG465HX) extends the same control stack to solar
productsAndServices.soldThrough: Embedded in Sungrow BESS/PV systems; PCS also sold to storage integrators
productsAndServices.targetSegments: Weak-grid and high-renewables-penetration markets — MEA, Australia, Chile, UK, Iberia
productsAndServices.roadmap: Grid-forming rollout tracking European grid-code evolution through 2026

productsAndServices.name: EV charging (Sungrow Charging)
productsAndServices.description: AC and DC charger portfolio from 11 kW to 480 kW for residential, commercial, and public applications — IDC30E (30 kW compact DC), IDC180E, and the flagship IDC480E-C ultra-fast compact DC charger (May 2025, Power2Drive Munich): built on Sungrow's proprietary 40 kW power modules at >97% efficiency, isolated air-cooling with fully sealed dust-free chamber, IP65 and C5 anti-corrosion protection, 10+ year design life with AI-supported lifecycle management.
highlights: Sold as part of the 'Beyond Charging' unified PV + ESS + EV-charging solution under one brand
productsAndServices.positioning: Leverages the shared power-module platform and existing distribution vs dedicated charging vendors (ABB, Alpitronic, Kempower, Chinese module makers)
productsAndServices.soldThrough: Distribution and charge-point-operator/fleet projects; bundled with PV+storage solutions
productsAndServices.targetSegments: Charge-point operators, fleet depots, fuel retailers, C&I sites pairing charging with PV and storage
productsAndServices.roadmap: IDC480E-C rollout from mid-2025 across Europe

productsAndServices.name: Green hydrogen (Sungrow Hydrogen)
productsAndServices.description: Subsidiary supplying both alkaline (ALK) and PEM water electrolyzers plus the power-supply and gas-liquid separation/purification balance of plant. Largest single units: 2,000 Nm³/h ALK (released 2024) and 300 Nm³/h PEM (May 2025). Annual production capacity ~3 GW. Runs flexible hybrid ALK+PEM plants tuned to variable renewable input.
highlights: Started production May 2025 at the world's largest dual-technology (ALK+PEM hybrid) green hydrogen plant
Selected to supply electrolyzers for ACME's 320 MW green-ammonia project in Oman; sales span three continents (trade-press characterization)
productsAndServices.positioning: One of the leading Chinese electrolyzer suppliers, differentiating on rectifier/power-electronics pedigree (the electrolyzer power supply is a Sungrow core competence) and dual-technology flexibility
productsAndServices.soldThrough: Direct EPC-style supply to green hydrogen/ammonia project developers
productsAndServices.targetSegments: Green hydrogen/ammonia megaprojects in China, the Middle East, and export markets
productsAndServices.roadmap: 300 Nm³/h PEM commercialization from May 2025; capacity built out to ~3 GW/year

productsAndServices.name: Floating PV (Sungrow FPV)
productsAndServices.description: Floating-body (HDPE float), anchoring, and mooring systems plus one-stop design services (preliminary/detailed design, third-party certification coordination, on-site support) for reservoirs, mining pits, and near-shore sites. New SGF-TS30M modular system (Intersolar Europe, May 2025) uses pre-assembled components to cut installation time ~30%. Over 4 GW of floating PV deployed worldwide.
highlights: Supplied the 192 MWp Cirata project in Indonesia — first 100 m deep-water floating PV plant, with custom high-load-bearing anchors
Anchoring & mooring design methodology verified by DNV under its floating-solar Recommended Practice
productsAndServices.positioning: One of the leading global floating-PV system suppliers (vs Ciel & Terre and regional float makers), strongest in deep-water and harsh-condition anchoring engineering
productsAndServices.soldThrough: Project-based supply with engineering services to developers and EPCs
productsAndServices.targetSegments: Reservoir/hydropower operators, land-constrained Asian and European markets, hybrid FPV-hydro-storage projects
productsAndServices.roadmap: Investing in improved anchoring systems and FPV-hydropower-storage hybrid integration (company statements, 2025)

productsAndServices.name: Wind power converters
productsAndServices.description: Full-power converters (2–8 MW single units) and doubly-fed converters (1.5–6.25 MW single units; product line addresses 1.5–26 MW turbines) at 690 V / 1,140 V / 1,800 V / 3,300 V voltage grades, IP54, air- or liquid-cooled, with paralleled-IGBT designs for weak-grid and off-grid duty. Innovations include an 1,800 V ultra-high-power converter platform, wind grid-forming, and low-frequency transmission support.
highlights: Long-standing major converter vendor to Chinese wind turbine OEMs; volume figures not published
productsAndServices.positioning: Merchant converter supplier to turbine OEMs that don't build their own — a China-centric business adjacent to the PV/storage power-electronics platform
productsAndServices.soldThrough: OEM component supply to wind turbine manufacturers

productsAndServices.name: Digital energy — iSolarCloud & O&M services
productsAndServices.description: iSolarCloud monitoring and management platform for PV and storage plants: plant access, remote parameter configuration, generation-trend monitoring, AI-based fault diagnosis and warning push, full lifecycle O&M. Serves 1M+ users in 150+ countries on four international servers with tens of GW of plants connected (56 GW at the 2023 relaunch). Feeds Sungrow's EMS layer for storage dispatch and provides the data backbone for AI-driven services like battery health management.
highlights: Bundled with every inverter/BESS sale — the recurring-relationship layer over the hardware installed base
productsAndServices.positioning: Competes with independent monitoring SaaS and rival OEM platforms (Huawei FusionSolar, SMA ennexOS); differentiates on installed-base scale and storage EMS integration
productsAndServices.soldThrough: Bundled with hardware; O&M service contracts for utility fleets
productsAndServices.targetSegments: Plant owners, O&M providers, residential/C&I installers, storage operators

recentDevelopments.headline: 7.5 GWh of PowerTitan 3.0 plus 2.6 GW of inverters for Masdar's 5.2 GW / 19 GWh round-the-clock solar+storage project in Abu Dhabi (COD 2027)
